title: Power from any two values (P, E, I, R)
idea: Watts, volts, amps and ohms are locked together. Know any two and you can find the other two.

lines: Know volts and ohms: P = E² / R
Know amps and ohms: P = I² x R
Need volts from watts and ohms: E = √(P x R)
Work in base units: 7 mA = 0.007 A

compare.how: Use when you know volts and ohms (G5B03).
Use when you know amps and ohms (G5B05).
Use when you know volts and amps (G5B04).

traps.why: 400 / 800 = 0.5 is the current in amperes, not the power. Square the volts: 400 x 400 / 800 = 200 W.
Right digits, wrong prefix. 7 mA is 0.007 A, so the power is 0.061 W = 61 milliwatts.
346 V is the peak (245 x 1.414). The question asks for RMS: √(1200 x 50) = 245 V.
